script: Decision: requires further review. The reported burst supply pipe damaging personal belongings fits the accidental plumbing discharge peril in CA-HO4-WATER. Notice was given 44 days after discovery, but whether that delay breached the prompt-notice duty and prejudiced the insurer under CA-HO4-NOTICE remains unresolved. Next action: Clarify the circumstances of delayed reporting and determine whether the delay impaired inspection or otherwise prejudiced the insurer before issuing a final coverage determination.
